kanban.worktreeCleanupNotStaged: This task has a worktree with changes that have not been merged. Delete the worktree to mark as done, or cancel to review the changes first.

queue.limitReached: Parallel task limit reached ({{current}}/{{max}}). Task moved to queue.
queue.autoPromoted: Task auto-promoted from queue to In Progress.

settings.title: Queue Settings
settings.description: Configure the maximum number of tasks that can run in parallel in the "In Progress" board
settings.hint: When this limit is reached, new tasks will wait in the queue before moving to "In Progress"

files.title: Files
files.selectFile: Select a file to view its contents

images.pasteHint: Tip: Paste screenshots directly with {{shortcut}} to add reference images.

notifications.backgroundTaskDescription: The task is still running. You can reopen this dialog to monitor progress.

wizard.createDescription: Describe what you want to build. The AI will analyze your request and create a detailed specification.
wizard.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the feature, bug fix, or improvement you want to implement. Be as specific as possible about requirements, constraints, and expected behavior. Type @ to reference files.

worktreeNotice.title: Isolated Workspace
worktreeNotice.description: This task runs in an isolated git worktree. Your main branch stays safe until you choose to merge.

gitOptions.title: Git Options (optional)
gitOptions.helpText: Override the branch this task's worktree will be created from. Leave empty to use the project's configured default branch.
gitOptions.pushNewBranchesDescription: Publish this task branch to GitHub and set upstream tracking automatically. Disable to keep it local-only.
gitOptions.useWorktreeDescription: Creates changes in a separate git worktree for safe review before merging. Disable to build directly in your project (faster but riskier).

errors.createFailed: Failed to create task. Please try again.

feedback.dragDropHint: Drag & drop images or paste screenshots

review.mergeTooltip: Merges changes from the task's worktree branch back to your base branch. AI will resolve any conflicts. You can then choose whether to keep or remove the worktree.

edit.title: Edit Task
edit.description: Update task details including title, description, classification, images, and settings. Changes will be saved to the spec files.

errors.updateFailed: Failed to update task. Please try again.

form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the feature, bug fix, or improvement you want to implement. Be as specific as possible about requirements, constraints, and expected behavior.
form.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty to auto-generate from description
form.titleHelpText: A short, descriptive title will be generated automatically if left empty.
form.requireReviewDescription: When enabled, you'll be prompted to review the spec and implementation plan before the coding phase begins. This allows you to approve, request changes, or provide feedback.
form.fastModeDescription: Same Opus 4.6 model with faster output. Higher cost per token.
form.fastModeNotice: Requires "extra usage" enabled on your Claude subscription.

errors.invalidImageType: Invalid image type. Allowed: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP

classification.helpText: These labels help organize and prioritize tasks. They're optional but useful for filtering.

subtasks.emptyBody: Implementation subtasks will appear here after planning

screenshot.title: Capture Screenshot
screenshot.description: Select a screen or window to capture as a reference image

devMode.title: Screenshot capture unavailable
devMode.description: Screen capture is not available in development mode due to system permission restrictions.
devMode.hint: Use an external screenshot tool and paste directly into the task description with {{shortcut}}.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Task
deleteDialog.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete
deleteDialog.destructiveWarning: This action cannot be undone. All task files, including the spec, implementation plan, and any generated code will be permanently deleted from the project.
deleteDialog.uncommittedChanges: This task's worktree has {{count}} uncommitted file(s)
deleteDialog.uncommittedChangesHint: These changes have not been committed or merged. Deleting this task will permanently discard all uncommitted work in the worktree.

referenceImages.title: Reference Images (optional)
referenceImages.description: Add visual references like screenshots or designs to help the AI understand your requirements.

agentQuestions.title: {{role}} is asking
agentQuestions.intro: The agent is paused until you answer. Pick an option or write your own; skipping lets it decide and note the assumption.

workspace.loadError: Could not read this task's files.

noSpecDir.title: Nothing written yet
noSpecDir.body: The spec, plan and architecture appear here as the agents write them into the task's spec directory.

spec.noQa: QA has not reported yet — results appear after the QA review.
spec.emptyBody: The spec writer creates spec.md with numbered acceptance criteria (AC-1 … AC-n) before anything is planned.
spec.noCriteriaBody: The spec has no lines marked **AC-n**, so coverage cannot be tracked.

plan.graphLabel: Plan dependency graph. Use Tab to move between subtasks.
plan.selectHint: Select a subtask to see what it covers and depends on.
plan.emptyBody: The planner writes implementation_plan.json after the architecture is done: phases, subtasks and the test each one writes first.

timeline.title: What happened
timeline.subtitle: From recorded log timestamps
timeline.emptyBody: Each phase, agent session and subtask is listed here with its real start and end time once the agents start.

architecture.noPreview: No rendered preview next to this diagram yet.
architecture.mermaidError: This Mermaid diagram could not be rendered.
architecture.emptyBody: The architect writes architecture.md, decision records and diagrams after the spec is approved and before planning.
architecture.noDocBody: The architect's narrative and planner constraints appear here.
architecture.noAdrs: No decisions recorded. The architect adds an ADR for each hard-to-reverse choice.
architecture.noDiagrams: No diagrams yet. The architect adds diagrams before planning.

security.gatesMeta: gitleaks · OSV-Scanner · before every QA review
security.gatesClear: Clear — no secrets or newly introduced vulnerable dependencies in what this task changed.
security.gatesBlocked: {{count}} finding(s) block QA until they are fixed.
security.pentestClear: Strix found nothing exploitable at the threshold in the changed code.
security.emptyBody: Secret and dependency scans run before every QA review. If Security QA is on in Settings, a Strix penetration test runs after QA approves.
security.noGates: The gates run before the first QA review.
security.noPentest: Security QA (Strix) is off, or QA has not approved yet. Turn it on in Settings → Agent Settings.

writes.planner: Subtasks, each with its failing test
writes.coder: Test first, in an isolated worktree

subtasks.title: Subtasks
subtasks.emptyBody: The planner splits the spec into subtasks, each naming the failing test it writes first. They appear here with their status.

checks.title: Checks
checks.noCriteria: No AC-n lines in the spec

description.title: Description
description.empty: No description. Edit the task to add one.

taskDetail.cannotResumeBody: The implementation plan could not be loaded. Try again, or check the task files.
taskDetail.deleteFailed: The task could not be deleted.

warnings.stuckBody: It is marked as running, but no agent process was found. This happens when the app quit or the process was killed.
warnings.incompleteBody: It has a spec and a plan, but {{done}} of {{total}} subtasks are done. Resume to continue the implementation.

workspaceErrors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred while loading workspace information

input.explain: The brief analyst reads your brief together with the project's code and proposes epics and tasks. You review and edit them first — nothing is created yet.
input.dropHere: Drop a spec or brief here
input.unsupported: This file type can't be read. Use one of: {{types}}
input.pickFailed: The file dialog didn't open. Try again, or drop the file here.
input.noPath: This file can't be read from where it was dropped. Use Choose file instead.
input.textPlaceholder: For example: customers can create invoices, send them by email as PDF and see which ones are unpaid…
input.textHint: A few sentences are enough; the analyst fills in the rest from the code and lists what it assumed.
input.fileWins: The file will be analysed. Remove it to describe the work in text instead.

analysing.title: Reading {{source}} and the project
analysing.body: The analyst is matching the brief to the code and splitting it into tasks. Long briefs can take a few minutes.
analysing.nothingYet: Nothing is created until you review the proposal. Cancelling stops the analyst.

review.losesDependency_one: Will be created without its dependency on {{keys}}, which is left out.
review.losesDependency_other: Will be created without its dependencies on {{keys}}, which are left out.
review.dependentsLose_one: {{keys}} depends on this task and will be created without that dependency.
review.dependentsLose_other: {{keys}} depend on this task and will be created without that dependency.
review.noCriteria: No criteria yet. The spec writer drafts them if you leave this empty.
review.questionsNote: You don't have to answer here: the spec agents ask these again for each task they affect.
review.orderHint: Tasks in a wave can run side by side; a wave starts when the tasks it depends on are done.
review.nothingSelected: No tasks selected. Check at least one task to create it.
review.cycleBody: {{keys}} wait on each other, so none of them can start. Uncheck one or change the brief.
review.queueOn: Tasks start as capacity and their dependencies allow.
review.queueOff: Tasks go to Planning; you start them yourself.

done.label: Created
done.queued: They are in the queue and start as capacity and their dependencies allow.
done.planning: They are in Planning. Start them when you're ready.

discard.title: Discard this proposal?
discard.body: Your edits are lost and the brief has to be analysed again.

errors.analyseUnknown: The analyst stopped without a proposal.

logs.emptyHint: Logs will appear here when the task runs
